project_type: Next.js 16.2.10 App Router with React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4
verification_instructions: Run npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint to verify no type errors or lint issues
environment_constraints: No docker daemon available. Build verification via tsc and lint only. GitHub power for push.
contribution_requirements: NEVER use useSyncExternalStore. Use useState(() => ...) for localStorage. NEVER call router.push() during render. typeof window !== undefined guard before localStorage. No hardcoded hex colors - use CSS variables or Tailwind. Mobile responsive.
key_patterns: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). CSS variables for colors (var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-success), var(--foreground), etc.). lucide-react for icons. localStorage for all user data. Session types defined in src/features/question-bank/types/index.ts.
directory_structure: src/app/ (29 routes), src/features/ (19 feature modules), src/shared/ (cross-feature code), src/scripts/ (CLI tools)
